documents.title: Framework agreement
documents.text:
Framework agreement: Brennick Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
For Brennick Logistics, warranty period in FY2025 was 10 months, as restated in the latest accounts. Incident response time at Brennick Logistics stood at 3 hours in FY2024, second issue (corrects the first issue). Brennick Logistics had performance bond of SEK 13.4m in FY2024 (reported basis). For Brennick Logistics, annual service charges with effect from 1 Jan 2025 was SEK 13.6m (reported basis). The force majeure scope for Brennick Logistics is understood as follows: excludes any labour dispute. As to Brennick Logistics, the exclusivity is: the customer may appoint other providers at any time.

documents.title: Change order
documents.text:
Change order: Brennick Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
For Brennick Logistics, warranty period in FY2025 was 11 months, as originally reported. Delay penalty cap at Brennick Oy stood at 12.9% in FY2024. Brennick Logistics had volume rebate of roughly 5.9% in FY2025. For Brennick Logistics, annual service charges with effect from 1 Jul 2025 was SEK 17.3m (reported basis). The force majeure scope for Brennick Logistics is understood as follows: includes supplier labour disputes.

documents.title: Procurement evaluation note
documents.text:
Procurement evaluation note: Brennick Logistics (fictional, authored test material).
For Brennick Logistics, incident response time in FY2024 was 4 hours, first issue. Performance bond at Brennick Nordic, a subsidiary stood at SEK 17m in FY2024 (reported basis). Brennick GmbH had delay penalty cap of 14.4% in FY2024. For Brennick Logistics, volume rebate in FY2025 was 6.1%. As to Brennick Logistics, the exclusivity is: the supplier is the exclusive provider for the term.
